'''Welex Korofu''' was an ace [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who trained in the canyons of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endex]]. Korofu's crashed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was later recovered by archaeologists from where it lay in the canyons.<ref name="Mission" />
